page.overview:
What is West Blue?

The West Blue is the ocean which makes up the west part of the Blue Sea split by the Red Line and the Grand Line. It is separated from the South Blue by the Red Line and the North Blue by the New World half of the Grand Line.

It is known to be the birthplace of the Straw Hat Pirates' archaeologist, Nico Robin, and musician Brook; the captain of the Rocks Pirates, Rocks D. Xebec; the Emperor Red-Haired Shanks; the Knights of God Figarland Shamrock and Manmayer Gunko; former Warlord of the Sea, Gecko Moria; and one of the members of the Worst Generation, Capone Bege. Other notable pirate crews from this sea include the Rumbar Pirates and the Happo Navy.

The West Blue is also known for having a strong Underworld scene due to the presence of five influential mafia organizations known collectively as the Five Families of the West. Another family with major ties to the Underworld, the Davy Family, was known to secretly live in this sea as well.

Over 60 years ago, a country in the West Blue unaffiliated itself with the World Government. It was reportedly wiped off the map after this, which the people of the Esperia Kingdom believed to be directly related.
